guest.bio_context: Cam Richardson is a two-time founder who previously bootstrapped a billing platform processing hundreds of millions of dollars. He went full-time with PaySquad eight months ago after spinning it out from that foundation. He has built an exceptional founding team including Sam Schaefer, former first employee at Afterpay US who led blue-tip deals with Macy's and Urban Outfitters, and Joel, an ex-e-commerce founder and product leader.

pending_qa.q: What is PaySquad's go-to-market strategy for landing enterprise merchants?
pending_qa.r: The company uses a combination of inbound requests and organic discovery through ChatGPT and Google Search, combined with integration speed—merchants can go live in under 20 minutes on Shopify. For the $520 million baby brand deal, Richardson made a chance connection on LinkedIn, securing a 12-month category exclusivity with potential extension to 18 months if hitting a million-dollar run rate target.

pending_qa.q: What viral coefficient and customer acquisition dynamics does PaySquad leverage?
pending_qa.r: PaySquad has the K-factor of an early 2000s social network. In one sale, the squad leader pulls in between 5 to 7 new people, providing exceptional organic growth similar to how Afterpay signed up a million customers spending less than a million dollars on marketing. Merchants are also placing PaySquad on their product description pages, driving organic discovery.
